entities.summary: Jacques Benoit-Gonnin is a French prelate of the Catholic Church who has been Bishop of Beauvais since 2010. He is a member of the Emmanuel Community. Jacques Benoit-Gonnin was a religious figures from Thoiry (b. 1952-06-24, Thoiry). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Shaped religious practice and spiritual communities.
